results.title: Sync device content? at sign-in
results.checks: A fresh browser highlights John 3:35 signed out; signing in asks 'Sync device content?' — 'This device is storing highlights that are not associated with any account…' with Don't add and Add to account; Don't add takes the highlight off; in another fresh browser, Add to account keeps it as yours
results.note: asked 'Sync device content?' about highlights; Don't add took it off; Add to account kept it
